parameters.rotation_theta: Discrete quarter turns {0, 90, 180, 270} degrees CCW (rigid planar, no reflections/mirroring)
parameters.translation_dx_dy: Continuous 2D translation (dx, dy) within [-50, +50] pixels (25% of image width/height)

search_stages.coarse: 16x16 FFT phase correlation on downsampled representations across 4 rotation angles
search_stages.refine: 64x64 sub-pixel phase correlation with Hanning windowing
search_stages.verification: Original 200x200 resolution joint intensity NCC (>= 0.85) and Sobel gradient field NCC (>= 0.85)
